The memo accurately captures all key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is a first amendment that only modifies one specific provision (Section 7.6(iii)) regarding Restricted Payments timing, extending the deadline to December 31, 2023. The memo correctly identifies that most financial terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.) are not available in this amendment document and appropriately marks them as "N/A". All material parties (borrower, administrative agent, lenders), dates (original agreement January 3, 2023, amendment March 31, 2023), and the specific covenant modification are properly captured in the memo.
